emission_traps: the class body is inside a class declaration, so IDTOString is inline and MSVC emits nothing unless something in the TU references it (the original Client.cpp did, which is why Roblox.exe has it). Two traps were found by experiment: making the trigger `static` lets the optimizer delete it as dead code (verified: an object with no .text at all), and making the POINTER `(*const p)` turns the initializer into a constant expression so MSVC folds it and emits no .text COMDAT for the function. The working form is a plain external-linkage non-const pointer: `const char* (*kExposerIDTOStringRef)(int) = &Exposer::IDTOString;`
